title: Midwest PHP 2017 Conference Call for Papers is Open
content:
The Midwest PHP conference is thrilled to announce the opening of their Call for Papers at through November 15, 2016. https://cfp.midwestphp.org

is launching into its fifth year at the Radisson Blu at Mall of America on March 17-18. With the growth of the Midwest PHP conference this is the one conference you cannot afford to miss in 2017.Midwest PHP 2017 Conference
